authority: 用户：没有新输入，请重新研究并制定下一实验；本轮研究设计，不执行Stage112
question: How does the reconstructed pz0>50 GeV requirement, with all other nominal MC cuts held fixed, change traditional low-energy risk, truth transfer and longitudinal muon response in six saved PHYS parents?
scope_limits: saved reconstructed PHYS denominator only; no generator/transport acceptance
convenience sources from historical QA; no population representativeness claim
selection composition is not proof of a changed conditional at fixed full observables
no new fit, forward, offset, test prediction, source production, threshold optimization or promotion

selection.G0: all effective nominal MC cuts except LeadTrack_pz0>50; retain truth_pz_nu>50 and all fitted-charge, quality, geometry, effective requires cuts
selection.Gplus: G0 and finite pz0>0 and finite E_nu>0
selection.S50: G0 and LeadTrack_pz0>50; separately identify defined-error subset
selection.S100: G0 and LeadTrack_pz0>100; descriptive historical reference only
selection.invalid_policy: keep full native cutflow, independent cut fail/unknown counts and invalid-but-native-pass shadow counts; do not silently change nominal selection
selection.raw_charge_policy: models retain raw11/status; audit legacy fitted-charge cuts without changing thresholds or swapping to raw
selection.no_track_or_unknown_truth: one parent entry one record, explicit undefined/missing; never zero-impute or flatten away
selection.fallback_minus1234: intentional no-fallback-needed control value, not physical charge corruption
selection.signed_negatives: apply typed rules in declared units; retain legitimate negative raw readings, charge sign and module_eta; unknown conventions remain unknown
selection.truth_out_of_domain: retain and count E_mu/E_nu outside (0,1] or y outside [0,1); do not clip or silently redefine valid primary
selection.leading: highest reconstructed pz0, never truth-matched substitute

identity.incoming_key: exact native (truth_pdg[0],truth_px[0],truth_py[0],truth_pz[0]) in MeV; proxy, not independent generator genealogy
identity.priority: test>cal>train; all known test-key parent views isolated from primary development contrast but counted in full parent cutflow
identity.other_collisions: retain original per-row quarantine where linked; count role collisions separately; never overwrite known role by source label
identity.new_parent_entries: diagnostic-only, no insertion in existing train/cal/test
identity.join: source+input_entry with checked native run/event, not global eventID

estimand.primary: for each E bin: mean of six per-source [weighted MSE(log(Ehat/E_nu)) in (S50 intersect Gplus) minus that in Gplus]
estimand.weights: within each source, each eligible incoming total parent-view weight1; freeze before Gplus/S50; source means combined with fixed1/6 each
estimand.undefined: if either arm in any source lacks support, that six-source endpoint is not estimable; no drop-and-renormalize
secondary: primary muon valid and leading confirmed fractions
full parent and independent-cut fail/unknown counts

decomposition.population: same subsets restricted to unique valid primary and finite positive E_mu_vertex; report counts excluded from decomposition but retained in primary risk
decomposition.interpretation: r includes angle, material, reference-plane differences and wrong-leading effects, not pure tracker resolution
decomposition.truth_definition: same signed PDG/vertex definition as frozen_evaluation.truth_diagnostics: unique muon at incoming neutrino decay vertex within0.0001mm in each axis; barcode and parent barcode/PDG for leading confirmation; empty/multiple/misaligned explicit unknown

fixed_diagnostics.legacy_layers: retain original eight strict mask definitions as additional table, not rebinned substitutes
fixed_diagnostics.unknown: no leading, invalid pz, primary missing/multiple, unmatched, typed invalid, aux unavailable, nonphysical truth quantities all explicit

uncertainty.method: incoming-cluster Poisson(1) multiplier bootstrap; common key multiplier across sources and both arms, fixed source/view weights
uncertainty.invalid_draws: count; no redraw-until-success; omit interval when below minimum
uncertainty.scope: conditional on six fixed PHYS sources; no source/refit/research-selection/systematic/new-blind certification
uncertainty.two_primary_bins: both reported without selecting the favorable one; descriptive intervals not model promotion tests

QA.real_entries: first4 entries per source (24), then at most16 original Stage105 records belonging to six sources sorted by row; deduplicate without replacement
checks: effective requires, aux and calibration configuration
complete native S50 membership equals independent masks
cached S50 intersection preserved; do not assume cache equals entire parent selection
all masks and invalid counts conserve full denominator
QA.before_full_run: check full six-file schema/entries and actual QA byte/timing/basket projection; no numerical outcome-based admission

resources.projection: factor3 using measured QA and complete branch/basket and entry metadata, plus reserves; do not scale40-entry bytes as physical flux
resources.accounting: external GNU CPU/wall/RSS, per-worker diagnostics, interface bytes and available ROOT bytes; do not add nested timing; physical network unmeasured unless instrumented
resources.IO: read only scalar/truth/leading-match branches; reuse baskets; stream compact scalar aggregates; no spacepoint/waveform/xAOD copies; delete temporary ROOT, row tables and transport duplicates

acceptance: all six sources and original roles/K/invalid/tails accounted for
native selection and exact identity closure pass
both primary endpoints or exact non-estimability reasons reported
decomposition closes with signed cross terms and population counts
zero or adverse mechanism effect still completes scientific test
stop: unavailable fixed source/schema/aux or inconsistent native selection: report precise missing item; no replacement
entries/resource admission fails: do not prefix truncate, enlarge budgets or start repeated QA loop
after one complete measurement: no automatic model, threshold, source or production follow-up
